meaning:
1) a rumbling, growling, moaning
1a) a rumbling, growling
1b) a moaning
1c) a sigh, moan, sighing

elsewhere.note: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.
For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.
